review.assessment: The change introduces a naive string reversal that compares characters directly without normalizing case or filtering non-alphanumeric content. It completely ignores the explicit task requirement to ignore spaces, punctuation, and case differences. As written, it will incorrectly reject standard test cases like "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama".

findings.call: isPalindrome("A man, a plan, a canal: Panama")
findings.defect: Ignores case sensitivity and fails to strip spaces/punctuation.
Fails mixed-case palindromes due to raw character-for-character equality check.
